subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted non-transient gateway disconnects land with this timeout-style fresh-session embedded fallback, or should this PR wait for a reattach-first design?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session duplicate-turn bug, but it intentionally preserves duplicate execution on a different fallback session; that user-visible tradeoff is a product choice tied to the open reattach-first proposal.

options.title: Land focused fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path and handle reattach-first behavior in the linked follow-up issue.

options.title: Pause for reattach-first
options.body: Hold this PR until accepted disconnects first wait for the in-flight gateway run and only recook locally as a last resort.

options.title: Split by delivery mode
options.body: Ask for a narrower variant that keeps interactive recook-first behavior but avoids duplicate `--deliver` sends by reattaching or returning in-flight status for delivery runs.

recommendation.title: Land focused fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path and handle reattach-first behavior in the linked follow-up issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent CLI gateway-dispatch history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the fallback behavior choice.
